Welcome!



I am a recent Ph.D. graduate with a strong passion for leveraging AI to solve real-world problems. This website showcases my academic journey, research achievements, and contact information. I am actively seeking opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research and development in the field of Artificial Intelligence.

About Me
I am Dr. Anya Sharma, a highly motivated and skilled researcher with a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Stanford University. My research interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing. I am eager to contribute my expertise to challenging and impactful projects.

title: About
text:
Publications

“Large Language Models are Zero-Shot Reasoners”, NeurIPS, 2022. Demonstrated that large language models can perform complex reasoning tasks without task-specific training.
“Chain of Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models”, ArXiv, 2022. Introduced a novel prompting technique that significantly improves the reasoning abilities of large language models.
“Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models”, ArXiv, 2022. Investigated the relationship between model size, dataset size, and compute budget for training large language models.
